game_updates.title: Vendhyan building, armor and weapon cosmetics arrive in Conan Exiles Enhanced
game_updates.contents: Greetings Exiles,  Today, we’re excited to unveil a new addition to Conan Exiles Enhanced: a richly detailed Vendhyan building set and armor and weapon cosmetics, bringing the splendor, color, and craftsmanship of the Hyborian Age’s eastern realms to your settlements. Build with Eastern Elegance Drawing inspiration from the lore of Vendhya, this set introduces a distinct architectural style defined by ornate carvings, sweeping silhouettes, and vibrant decorative elements. game_updates.title: Introducing the Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader Launcher
game_updates.contents: Lord Captains! We’re introducing Owlcat Launcher to Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader! The launcher is designed to serve as a hub, helping you stay up to date with the latest news while getting into the game as quickly as ever. Have no worries – your adventures, saves, mods, and the game itself remain unchanged. The launcher will just make news, updates and games’ content more accessible and easier to find. Our launcher is still on its way to the final form – we plan to continue developing it, adding new features and improvements designed to make your experience with our games more convenient and enjoyable. Priceless international works of art have adorned its hallways for years, and now the time has come to raid this prestigious gallery’s esteemed collection for personal gain in The Kortz Center Heist, this summer's exciting new update coming to GTA Online in July. game_updates.contents: The Cased & Coiled Update is out now!This update includes 2 new main processing machines, elevators, unpackager, improvements to boxes, and translations to 10 languages.Casing PressScrap accumulates as casings are created. When the machine is full, it will eject a Scrap Cube, which can be sold directly or recycled in a furnace.Wire CoilerStretches out Rods and links them together to make a Wire Coil. game_updates.title: Slay the Spire 2 gets a patch for broken RNG after player turns in gruelling eight hour video exposé
game_updates.contents: Slay the Spire 2 has received a major update that adds Steam Workshop support for mods alongside a proper monster bestiary for the Compendium. It also introduces a new boss, Aeonglass, in place of the much-berated Doormaker. These are pretty juicy changes, and yet, the most intriguing part of the patch is a deceptively dry question of disobedient mathematics. Read more

game_updates.title: Under The Hood: In-Game Map QA
game_updates.contents: Creating Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator is a collaborative effort involving many talented teams across SCS Software. While map designers, artists, programmers and more build the driving experience, another team works alongside them to ensure everything functions exactly as intended before players hit the road. In this Under the Hood blog, we'd like to introduce you to two members of our In-Game QA team, Ivan and David. We asked them about their day to day work, how testing fits into the development process, why quality assurance is about much more than simply playing the game and more! David - ATS Map QA Lead "Hey, fellow truckers! My name is David, and I'm 28 years old. I joined SCS as a junior tester when I was just 20, and at the time, I was the youngest employee in...

game_updates.title: Out of nowhere, excellent tactics game Battle Brothers gets a pile of dreadful swords - its first proper patch in a year
game_updates.contents: As you lean back in your chair with a sigh and count the hours left in the working day, a hideously hairy stranger appears in the door. His eyes are yellow and bulging, his beard rank with ale and bogwater, his helm battered and hung with viscera. He opens his stinking yap and bellows at you like an elephant seal with its whiskers trapped in a lawnmower. Then he drops a huge pile of crude, rusty weapons at your feet. That's right, it's finally time for a proper update for Battle Brothers, the mercenary tactics management sim beloved of the Nics we used to know. Read more

game_updates.title: A huge Slay the Spire 2 update makes life harder but fairer, and adds Steam mod support
game_updates.contents: The time has come. A new Slay the Spire 2 update is now live on the main branch, meaning months of changes that have been in public testing over on the beta build are now here for everyone. Among them are the introduction of the Aeonglass boss fight, the Bestiary, and a whole heap of balance changes, but that's just the start. Mega Crit has also managed to resolve its most pressing problem since launch with a fix for the 'correlated RNG' that was discovered this week, and opened up mod potential dramatically with full Steam Workshop support. Let's get into it. Read the full story on PCGamesN: A huge Slay the Spire 2 update makes life harder but fairer, and adds Steam mod support

game_updates.title: Major Update #2 - v0.107.1
game_updates.contents: Hey Slayers, our second major main branch update is here with 4 patches in 1 (not including hotfixes)! While we'll be covering a lot of things that beta players will already be used to, there are also a few big changes that will be totally new for everyone. One of those has been highly requested by the community in the past few days and another has been very highly requested by the community in the past few months, so let's get into it! RNG Rework Ed here, one of the Mega Crit engineers. It turns out that everyone complaining about receiving Debt too often from Neow's Bones was right! We did, in fact, have some unusual RNG problems. Huge shoutout to tckmn for doing the research - their eight-hour descent into madness was an entertaining watch, and we wouldn't have caught the issue without ...

game_updates.title: Happy's Humble Burger Farm Update 1.18.1
game_updates.contents: Hey everyone! Update 1.18.1 is now live. This patch focuses on stability, save reliability, display fixes, Steam Deck improvements, and a handful of issues reported by players. Thanks to everyone who sent in logs and bug reports. They helped us track down some stubborn issues. Obligatory mention: If you enjoyed the game, please consider leaving us a review. It helps greatly with visibility! Saves, Inventory & Collectibles Fixed the held-item counter on the HUD showing the wrong number of items, including cases where it showed zero dots while you were still holding something. Fixed items occasionally being dropped from your inventory when moving between areas. Inventory now stays in sync every time you change scenes. game_updates.title: Minor Update for 06/18/2026
game_updates.contents: Hey everyone! We're rolling out a quick minor update today to squash a few pesky bugs and polish up your Crosshair X experience. A huge thank you to everyone in the community who helped report these—your feedback keeps us moving forward! Here is what’s fixed in today's patch: 🪴Patch Notes & Fixes: Fixed an issue where the "Show only in-game" setting wasn't reliably detecting certain games. Resolved a visual layering quirk in the Designer when using the Draw tool. Your new brush strokes will no longer temporarily hide behind previous ones while you hold down the mouse! Fixed bugs related to animating arm visibility with color changes. Various under-the-hood internal fixes to keep everything running smoothly. game_updates.title: Battle Brothers Update v1.5.2.2 - New Weapons, Enemies, and More
game_updates.contents: Are you all ready for some fresh Battle Brothers content? If so, we have good news for you! We are releasing the first content update in about a year, but we can hopefully increase that pace a bit in the future. Steam Reviews: Your Feedback Matters!We'd also like to take a moment to say thank you for playing Battle Brothers, and we hope you enjoy this update! If we could make a simple request, we'd love it if you could take a moment to share your thoughts, feedback, and ideas in a Steam review. It's an awesome way to let us know what you think, whether positive or negative, especially as Battle Brothers continues to be updated.
